questions.question: Dr Chiba wants to hire a new assistant. He hesitates between a DUT graduate candidate and a candidate with 5 years of on-the-job experience. Dr Zaki advises him. What is the best selection criterion?
options: Experience is more important than the diploma
The diploma is more important than experience
Both diploma and experience should be combined for a complete evaluation
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'The diploma guarantees structured training, experience brings practical skills. Both are complementary.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki must train his new assistant. According to educational sciences, which training method is the most effective?
options: Training alternating theory and practice with a mentor
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'The alternation of theory and practice with a mentor allows the development of both technical skills and soft skills.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba has an assistant who has difficulty managing stress. According to good management practices, what is the best approach?
options: Offer support and stress management techniques
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'Support and stress management training are investments in the team's performance and well-being.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki must evaluate his assistant's skills. Which evaluation method is the most objective?
options: A standardized evaluation grid with precise criteria
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'A standardized evaluation grid allows objective assessment of technical, relational and organizational skills.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba must organize continuing education for his team. What is the recommended frequency?
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'Regular continuing education allows the team to stay up to date and improve their skills.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki has an assistant who lacks self-confidence. What is the best approach to develop her autonomy?
options: Give her progressive responsibilities with appropriate support
Put her in competition with others
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'Progressive delegation with support allows the development of confidence and autonomy.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba must manage a conflict between two assistants. What is the first step?
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'Individual listening allows understanding the causes of the conflict before finding a solution.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki must motivate his team of assistants. Which strategy is the most effective?
options: Regular recognition and career development prospects
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'Regular recognition and career development prospects are the most sustainable motivation levers.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba must recruit an assistant. What are the essential criteria to evaluate during the interview?
options: Technical skills, relational skills and soft skills
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'The evaluation must take into account technical skills, relational skills and soft skills for a successful recruitment.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki has an assistant who has difficulties with management software. What is the best solution?
options: Make her use the software without training
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'Specific training allows the assistant to master the tools and be more efficient.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba must organize his assistant's work. What is the best task distribution method?
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'Task distribution must take into account everyone's skills to optimize team efficiency.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki must evaluate his assistant's performance. Which indicators are the most relevant?
options: Quality of assisted care and patient satisfaction
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'Quality of assisted care and patient satisfaction are the most relevant performance indicators.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba must manage an assistant in difficulty. What is the right approach?
options: Identify the causes and propose a support plan
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'Identifying the causes and implementing a support plan allows resolving difficulties.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki must train a new assistant in the sterilization circuit. What is the most effective method?
options: Give her a manual to read
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'Practical demonstration with support allows the assistant to understand and master the sterilization circuit.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba must manage his assistant's schedule. What is the good practice for holidays?
options: Grant holidays at the last minute
Plan holidays in advance in consultation
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'Advance planning of holidays allows maintaining service continuity and respecting everyone's needs.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki must evaluate his assistant's professionalism. What are the criteria to consider?
options: Punctuality, ethics and quality of work
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'Professionalism is measured by punctuality, ethics and the quality of the work provided.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba must manage an assistant who refuses to follow protocols. What is the right approach?
options: Explain the importance of protocols and offer training
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'Explanation and training allow the assistant to adhere to protocols rather than imposing them.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki must organize communication within the team. Which tool is the most effective?
options: A logbook or shared digital tool
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'A shared tool allows clear and traceable communication between all team members.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba must manage an assistant in burnout. What is the priority?
options: Protect the assistant's health and offer support
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'The assistant's health is a priority. Support and burnout prevention are essential.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki must evaluate his assistant's training needs. Which method is the most suitable?
options: An individual interview with skills analysis
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'The individual interview with skills analysis allows precise identification of training needs.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba must create a career plan for his assistant. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'A career plan allows developing the assistant's skills and strengthening her motivation.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki must manage an assistant who has relational difficulties with patients. What is the right approach?
options: Put her in contact with difficult patients
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'Communication training allows the assistant to develop her relational skills.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba must organize teamwork with his assistant. What is the key to success?
questions.explanation: Dr Zaki explains: 'Complementary skills and good communication are the keys to an effective team.'

questions.question: Dr Zaki, after training several assistants, receives congratulations from Dr Chiba. What is the next step for Dr Zaki?
options: Create a mentoring program for new assistants
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba explains: 'Creating a mentoring program allows passing on knowledge and training the new generation.'

questions.question: Dr Chiba and Dr Zaki, after years of collaboration, have formed an exceptional team. What message do they wish to convey to young practitioners?
options: The assistant is an indispensable pillar of the practice
questions.explanation: Dr Chiba and Dr Zaki conclude: 'The assistant is an indispensable pillar of the practice, on par with the dentist.'
